assignments.reason: Prevent concurrent Gate-13 reverse-engineering and report/persistence edits while Codex owns closure.
assignments.non_owner_policy: Do not modify Gate-13 implementation, tests, audits/status files, report/persistence state, or shared files touched by the active Gate-13 PR. Continue only independent Gate-14+ work-ahead that does not touch those files or behaviors; otherwise checkpoint without duplicating work.
explicitly_forbidden_for_continuous_work: Any reconciliation of an active Codex Gate-13 branch unless explicitly assigned
allowed_for_continuous_worker: Independent Gate-14 work-ahead on disjoint files
Later-gate research/tooling that does not alter Gate-13/shared runtime state
assignments.release_condition: Gate 13 passes and main advances to Gate 14, or Daniel/coordination explicitly releases or reassigns this lock.
